Cc: Bryce Allen <bryce.allen@brightretail.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Channel promo endorsement & trial credits for CloudChannel pilot

Hi Karthik,

Quick intro — I'm Ben, GTM lead at CloudChannel. We're kicking off a co-sell pilot with BrightRetail (Bryce cc'd) to validate Redwood for in-store AI assistants. BrightRetail wants a 30-day, low-risk trial to evaluate latency and cost under real retail traffic.

Request: CloudChannel is asking Redwood to provide an initial pool of 50k token credits (applied to BrightRetail's tenant) as a partner-sponsored promo. CloudChannel will commit a 1-day joint technical kick-off, a partner-led integration checklist, and a short case study if the pilot converts.

Needed from Redwood:
- Confirmation we can issue partner-sponsored promo credits to BrightRetail for a 30-day trial
- Any standard terms we need signed (we attached our sponsorship intake form)
- Expected timeline for credit activation and any usage guardrails

Attached: partner_sponsorship_form.pdf (filled)

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful. Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Ben Mendoza
GTM Lead, CloudChannel
ben.mendoza@cloudchannel.co
[Attachment: partner_sponsorship_form.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel promo endorsement & trial credits for CloudChannel pilot

Hi Ben — thanks for the note and the clear ask. Welcome, Bryce.

We're generally supportive of partner-sponsored promos for strategic channel-led pilots. A few quick items so we can route this through our approval workflow:

1) Use case verification: can you confirm expected monthly token burn profile (tokens/day) and peak concurrency for BrightRetail?
2) Success criteria: what does a successful pilot look like to both CloudChannel and BrightRetail (e.g., latency < 350ms p95, conversion to paid POC)?
3) Contact for legal/SOW: who will sign the promo terms on BrightRetail's side?

Operationally, our usual path is a staged credit release (initial tranche + milestone-based top-up) rather than a single bulk grant. That helps limit risk and lets us fast-follow if conversion looks promising. I'll loop in Marissa (partner ops) and Olga (promo approvals) to evaluate.

If you can provide the three items above, we'll draft a promo agreement and a proposed staged-release plan.

Regards,
Karthik
Sr Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
